shorts_extract.hook: Rat #34 ignores a dish of food and presses a brain-wired brass lever nearly 2,000 times in one hour.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Olds & Milner's 1954 accidental bent-wire implant in the septal / medial forebrain bundle across 15 histologically mapped rats.
shorts_extract.twist: Modern affective neuroscience twist: the 'pleasure center' is actually a relentless mesolimbic 'wanting' engine that fires even without pleasure.
